description.value: A remote backcountry lake camp in Tweedsmuir Provincial Park (South), reached only by a 20 km trail with 1,000 m of elevation gain through alpine terrain — strictly hike-in and inaccessible to loaded touring bikes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Crystal Lake is tagged in OSM as a backcountry camp_site (backcountry=yes, tourism=camp_site) operated by BC Parks within Tweedsmuir Park. The BC Parks website confirms the site exists but describes it only in the context of a 20 km hiking trail with 1,000 m elevation gain — there is no mention of road or cycling access. No cycling-specific amenities, hiker/biker sites, or bicycle-relevant infrastructure are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
